pack.name: AWS Well-Architected Framework
pack.description: Reviewer prompts mapped to AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar themes. Grounded in read-only AWS inventory ZIP output and Terraform aws_* evidence. Not an official AWS Well-Architected Review or certification.

rules.title: Security — sensitive PaaS uses private connectivity
rules.description: High-sensitivity datastores must not rely on implicit public network paths when landing-zone standards expect VPC endpoints.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired=true on regulated datastores[] and align governance.ComplianceTags; cross-check aws_Network/privateEndpoints rows in resources.json when network inventory switches were enabled.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Secure networking and private access (pillar theme)

rules.title: Security — encryption at rest for persisted data
rules.description: Manifest datastores carrying customer or regulated payloads must assert EncryptionAtRestRequired consistent with platform CMK or Microsoft-managed key posture.
rules.remediationGuidance: Ensure EncryptionAtRestRequired=true on sensitive datastores[]; document key custody (AWS KMS, HSM) in governance.RequiredControls and relate to aws_KeyVault/vaults inventory when present in resources.json.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Protect data at rest (pillar theme)

rules.title: Security — AWS Policy compliance states reviewed
rules.description: When AWS Config compliance exports is included in the extractor ZIP, non-compliant assignments should be dispositioned or risk-accepted with traceable governance narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize Policy Insights non-compliance themes from AWS Config compliance exports in governance.PolicyConstraints; cite SubscriptionId and ScopeDescriptor for audit scope alignment.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Governance and regulatory compliance (pillar theme)

rules.title: Cost Optimization — compute SKUs justified against workload class
rules.description: aws_Compute/virtualMachines rows in resources.json should map vmSize choices to documented workload tiers; optional AWS Price List grounding supports unit-cost reasoning when IncludeRetailPrices was collected.
rules.remediationGuidance: Correlate properties.vmSize in resources.json with governance.PolicyConstraints; when AWS Price List grounding is absent, note that only inventory counts—not catalog estimates—are available until re-collection.

rules.title: Cost Optimization — resource tagging supports allocation
rules.description: CloudFormation/API inventory tags on resources.json rows should support cost allocation, environment classification, and owner attribution expected by FinOps practices.
rules.remediationGuidance: Audit tags on inventoried resources and mirror mandatory tag keys in services[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags for manifest services not yet exported to AWS.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Cost Optimization — Improve cost visibility (pillar theme)

rules.title: Operational Excellence — extractor evidence freshness documented
rules.description: Architecture reviews citing AWS inventory must record when evidence was collected and which extractor switches shaped the ZIP contents.
rules.remediationGuidance: Always cite awsExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp, SchemaVersion, and SwitchesUsed in metadata.ChangeDescription; upgrade AzModuleVersion when collector scripts change materially.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Operational Excellence — Operational procedures and evidence hygiene (pillar theme)

rules.title: Sovereign region pinning for regulated data planes
rules.description: When governance.ComplianceTags imply sovereignty or residency constraints, every inventoried data plane in resources.json must stay inside the declared geography; cross-region replication requires an explicit exception narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map datastores[].Region and services[].Region against governance.ComplianceTags; flag paired-region DR only when metadata.ChangeDescription cites an approved residency exception.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Data sovereignty and residency (pillar theme)

rules.title: Customer-managed key rotation cadence
rules.description: Stateful services using CMK encryption must document rotation ownership and maximum key age; silent long-lived keys are a review blocker for regulated tiers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reference AWS KMS key names in governance.RequiredControls and tie rotation cadence to governance.PolicyConstraints; cite resources.json AWS KMS and storage encryption rows when present.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Protect data with encryption and key governance (pillar theme)

rules.title: Idle and orphaned spend retirement policy
rules.description: Advisor cost and orphan-candidate rows in the extractor ZIP must map to an explicit retirement or exemption decision — not linger as unnamed technical debt.
rules.remediationGuidance: Link orphan-candidates.json and advisor-cost.json entries to findings with owner and target retirement date; use governance.CostClassification to mark accepted carry cost.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Cost Optimization — Eliminate waste and orphaned resources (pillar theme)

rules.title: Generative AI endpoint rate and quota guardrails
rules.description: Architecture narratives that expose LLM or embedding endpoints must document per-tenant throttling, budget cutoffs, and abuse detection — not unbounded inference surfaces.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record quota and budget policies on services[].Tags for AWS OpenAI / AI Search hosts; align with governance.PolicyConstraints for PilotStrict or production inference tiers.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Reliability — Protect workloads with rate limits and capacity guardrails (pillar theme)

rules.title: Hub-spoke peering and firewall inspection path
rules.description: Multi-subscription or hub-spoke designs must show which traffic paths are inspected by AWS Firewall or NVA — peering alone is not a security control.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document inspection points in relationships[].relationshipType and governance.RequiredControls; correlate aws_Network/virtualNetworks and firewall resources from resources.json.

frameworkMappings.requirement: Security — Network segmentation and inspected east-west paths (pillar theme)
